title: Request for feedback on claude boss modelling phaser 4 tripo assets with gemini texture overlay - how do I make his arms and legs more dynamic?
author: Thicthor96
selftext: General ask in video. Forgive me if I sound like a newbie to game dev, it's because I am a newbie

replies.author: DraconicBlade
replies.body:
Randombullshit GO!

Maybe start by not having your "Stomp" attack be a grid transformation of the sprite and a headbutt.

or a backhand? The sprite doesn't even animate.

replies.author: DraconicBlade
replies.body: Also, you have a "shadow" that is a static object, not even linked to the sprite behavior.

replies.author: Thicthor96
replies.body: It's an autobattler. You put together a build and see if it can overcome the mechanics of each boss. This guy returns damage, has stoneskin which reduces damage until it is broken by enough elemental damage, and he scales up player max% hp damage per attack every 10 seconds. So in turn your build has to sustain, have elemental, and ramp harder or u lose. it's silly & stupid

replies.author: Kindly-Sail6260
replies.body: Okay makes sense. I’ll say this if you’re comfortable with it since it looks more like an illustration and than actual sprites, break him up into parts. Separates arms legs body and head. That way AI can actually make animations and in a way add some charm to them since you’re not trying to be perfect with it. If you prefer to keep them all together. You’ll have to keep generating them until you get it perfect which can take a while. But doing it in the way I’m suggesting, will allow your characters to be as dynamically driven as possible while not worrying about realism. I’d do some tests to find out.

replies.author: Thicthor96
replies.body: Thank you! have a few threads going on that now

replies.author: Kindly-Sail6260
replies.body: I’d love to see the results once you’re done testing it!
